title: Non-Equilibrium Dissipative Typography
discipline: Non-Equilibrium Thermodynamics · Ilya Prigogine · Dissipative Structures · Self-Organizing Typography
hypothesis: Can digital typography be formulated as an open thermodynamic system far from equilibrium (governed by Ilya Prigogine's entropy balance dS = d_e S + d_i S where d_e S < 0), such that reader interaction friction continuously injects thermal entropy (d_i S > 0), but rather than degrading into disordered typographic noise, the page exports excess heat into margin convection currents and bifurcates past a critical Rayleigh/Prigogine threshold into self-organizing macroscopic Bénard hexagonal glyph cells and rhythmic editorial standing waves?
